# vendor/

Code in this folder was written by other people and copied in unchanged.
Please do not edit it.

- `js-yaml.js`: js-yaml version 4.1.0 (<https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml>),
  MIT licence (see `js-yaml-LICENSE.txt`). It lets the browser read
  `explore-world.yml`. It is the file `dist/js-yaml.mjs` from the official package,
  renamed to end in `.js`.
